{\begin{aligned}{u}_{1}\cdot x=0 \\ {u}_{2}\cdot x=0\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}{x}_{2}+\frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}{x}_{3}=0 \\ -\frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}{x}_{1}+\frac{3}{\sqrt{14}}{x}_{2}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}{x}_{3}=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we consider the augmented matrix $M$ of the system above and reduce it to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}} & \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}} & 0 \\ -\frac{2}{\sqrt{14}} & \frac{3}{\sqrt{14}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}} & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:=\sqrt{10}\cdot {R}_{1} \\ {R}_{2}:=\sqrt{14}\cdot {R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 3 & 0 \\ -2 & 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In the reduced matrix above, there are two pivot columns ($1$st and $2$nd). Thus, ${x}_{3}$ is a free variable. From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=3{x}_{3}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain 

$$
-2{x}_{1}+3(3{x}_{3})+{x}_{3}=0\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=5{x}_{3}.
$$

So, the general solution is

$$
[\begin{aligned}5{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}\in R.
$$

Setting ${x}_{3}=1,$ we obtain the vector 
$x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ 

Now, we need to normalize $x.$ Notice that $‖x‖=\sqrt{{5}^{2}+{3}^{2}+{1}^{2}}=\sqrt{35}.$ So, we normalize $x$ as follows:

$$
\frac{x}{‖x‖}=[\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{\sqrt{35}} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{35}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{35}}\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, an orthonormal basis of ${R}^{3}$ is

$$
{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-\frac{2}{\sqrt{14}} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{14}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{\sqrt{35}} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{35}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{35}}\end{aligned}]}.
$$

Finally, $|{x}_{1}|+|{x}_{2}|+|{x}_{3}|=|\frac{5}{\sqrt{35}}|+|\frac{3}{\sqrt{35}}|+|\frac{1}{\sqrt{35}}|=\frac{9}{\sqrt{35}}.$
